## Evidence report

**AC-R-2.8.2-14 (timing/size/zero-token).**
`flow::timing_tests::decision_cost_is_linear_in_rules_and_params`
(non-matching-selector workload, 10 iterations):

| run | 8 rules | 128 rules (16×) |
|---|---|---|
| cold-inclusive | 135.8 µs | 18.1 µs |
| warm | 9.4 µs | 18.2 µs |

The guard asserts `t128 < max(64·t8, 50 ms)` — a 16× rule growth
stays far inside quadratic (selector mismatch dominates; observed
ratio ≤ ~2× warm). `label_bytes` of a representative
`external`/`{tool}`-tainted label = **60 bytes ≤ LABEL_MAX_BYTES
(4096)**. Zero label tokens reach the model: `FlowInput`/`check_flow`
read canonical records only; the context assembler's
`HandleLeaked`/`context_label` paths keep `handle_only` content out
of model-facing `Text`.

**AC-R-2.8.2-3 (exfiltration fixture).** Injected recipient at
`authority ≤ external`/tainted → `deny{RobustnessViolated}` before
any ask; authorized recipient (alice ∈ readers) → `allow`;
unauthorized (carol) → `ask{remedies:[approval, sanitize]}` —
approval remedies only enumerated when attended (R1–R5).
